query: The Boats Keep Time Inside the boathouse every boat is knocking against its post in the same slow rhythm, though there's no wind and the water outside is still. Knock, knock, knock: seven, then a pause. Steady the boats You go from boat to boat with wet sleeves, holding each one still. As soon as you let go, they take up the rhythm again. Sit and listen You sit on an upturned hull and listen until you can hear the bell under the knocking. It is very far down, and very patient.
